body:
# Forgotten Realm
A forgotten realm, long lost to many, now rests within your grasp.
## 🌍Content Overview
Dimension Features
- **The Forgotten Realm** - a parallel world with unique terrain generation
- Three distinct biome types with specialized environmental effects
- Atmospheric lighting and fog effects for immersive exploration

### 🧱 Blocks and Items
**Building Blocks**:
- ```Shadowed Ore``` - Found underground in the new dimension
- ```Shadow Stone``` - Basic construction material
- ```Shadow Planks``` - Wood alternative with dark aesthetic
- ```Shadow Bricks``` and variants (Stairs, Slabs, Walls)

**Functional Blocks**:
- ```Shadowed Light``` - Bright light source (light level 15)
- ```Crystal Block``` - Glowing decorative block (light level 3)
- ```Ritual Altar``` - Progressively upgrading centerpiece block

**Tools**:
- ```Shadow Igniter``` - Special interaction tool (durability: 32)

### 📜 World Narrative
The Forgotten Realm tells its story through:

**Environmental Details** 🌄
- Precise block placement in generated structures
- Deliberate architectural patterns
- Biome-specific terrain formations

**Written Records** 📖
- In-game books containing fragmented accounts
- Item descriptions with historical references
- Structure-appropriate loot with contextual clues

**Gameplay Integration** ⚙️
- Mechanics that reinforce narrative elements
- Progressive revelation through advancement 
  - (WIP)
- Environmental storytelling techniques

## ⚙️ Technical Information
**Dimension Access**
Temporary command for testing:
```
/world forgotten_realm
```
**Key Block Mechanics:**
- ```Ritual Altar``` has 4 upgrade stages (0-3) with visual changes
- ```Shadow Igniter``` interacts with ```Crimson Planks``` and ```Heavy Core```
- ```Shadowed Light``` emits permanent light (no power needed)

**Entity Features:**
- ```Shadow Golem``` entity with custom behaviors
- Breedable using the ```Crystal``` item

**Requirement:**
- Minecraft: 1.21
- NeoForge

## 📖 Documentation Status
Project documentation is currently in development.
A [Forgotten Realm Wiki](https://forgotten-realm.fandom.com/wiki/Forgotten_Realm_Wiki) exists with preliminary information and will be:
- Gradually updated during development
- Completed for the first full release
- Expanded with each major update
